composed_rule: head = BlockCache lookup 0x514e550(outer): the matching record's +0x20 first qword, or 0 on a miss; the outer argument is passed unchanged
a null lookup result returns 0 with *out untouched
otherwise node = head; wrapper layout: inner pointer at +0x00, next wrapper at +0x38; dispatch slot = [inner + slot] where slot is 0x70, 0x78 or 0x98 per getter

the walk compares each visited node's dispatch slot against the contents of the getter's sentinel cell (0x5777a28 / 0x5777a78 / 0x5777a38); the first comparison reads the cell, later comparisons compare against the first dispatch value, which provably equals the cell contents on those paths
while the slot equals the sentinel, advance to the next wrapper, at most four times; the first non-sentinel slot is called with the wrapper, its result is stored at *out, and the getter returns 1
the fifth node is called unconditionally, without a sentinel comparison
the getters contain no PLT calls and no stack canary: the only call in each getter body besides the indirect dispatch calls is the direct rel32 call to the lookup
